title: Tourist Season, 2011
logline: Wood's first week on nights. He sleeps through August. The tourists are a rumor he hears from Gully.

panels.composition: The garage, 2 PM, blinds drawn. WOOD asleep face down on the bed, the polo still on. BARNABY asleep on the polo's back. Through the blinds: August, cars, voices drawn as small marks.

image.prompt: a garage apartment at 2 PM with the blinds drawn, a man asleep face down on a bed still wearing a maroon motel polo, an old dog asleep on his back, small voice-marks coming through the blinds, muddy flats

panels.composition: GULLY in the door with a coffee. Looking at the two of them. Setting it down. Leaving.

image.prompt: a stocky man in an apron quietly setting a paper cup of coffee on a table in a dim garage and leaving, a man and dog asleep, no words

panels.composition: 6 PM. Wood up. The coffee cold. A note under it in grease pencil: 'Town's full. You missed nothing. — G.'

image.prompt: a man holding a cold paper cup and reading a butcher-paper note in grease pencil beneath it
image.notes: Letter after: Town's full. You missed nothing. — G.

panels.composition: 10:40 PM. The polo. The lamp. The pad. Wood drawing the tourists he didn't see, from Gully's four words. The dog. The hum line beginning.

image.prompt: a man in a motel polo drawing at night under a green lamp with a dog beneath the table, a clock reading 10:40, a flat line beneath the panel, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: Nights. August as a rumor. 'You missed nothing.'
